title: Infinite Dimensions Mod
description: The ability to travel the multiverse and many other interesting features
body:
Infinite Dimensions
Infinite Dimensions is a content mod that expands Minecraft with a rich set of dimensional tools, utility items, magical gadgets, and new blocks — all centered around the theme of exploring, creating, and controlling dimensions. Whether you want to carve out your own private pocket dimension, warp across the world in an instant, or wield gadgets with wild effects, this mod has something for you.

✨ What Does This Mod Add?
🌀 Dimension Creation & Navigation
The heart of the mod. Create and manage custom dimensions on the fly:

Portal Wand — Sneak+use to bind to a dimension, then right-click a block to construct a portal to it.
Portal Key — A reusable key item bound to a specific dimension. Right-click to warp; sneak+use to unbind.
Warp Scroll — A single-use scroll pre-configured for a dimension via /warpscroll. Right-click to instantly warp.
Dimension Codex — A seed book for cataloging and seeding new dimensions.
Dimension Coin — Right-click to interact with the dimension system.
Dim Name Tag — Tag and rename your custom dimensions.
Rift Stone — A block that displays properties of the current dimension (ceiling, warmth, etc.).
Dimension Anchor — Anchors your position in a dimension; releases warp locks on interaction.
Dimension Tile — A buildable tile block native to the dimension system.

🧭 Exploration & Tracking
Never get lost across dimensions again:

Dimension Compass — Lists all known dimensions and their seed hashes.
Dimension Atlas — Displays a map of your current dimension.
Soul Compass — Tracks a bound entity or soul across dimensions.
Seed Detector — Displays detailed stats about the current dimension.
Dimension Beacon — A portable waypoint system. Sneak+use to mark a location; use to teleport back.
Dimension Broadcaster — Announces your current dimension and coordinates to all players (10s cooldown).
Echo Crystal — Save a position with sneak+use, then right-click to teleport back to it.

⚔️ Combat & Utility Gadgets
A big collection of powerful items with unique right-click abilities:
ItemEffectBlink DaggerTeleports you 20 blocks toward your cursor (3s cooldown)Inferno GauntletLaunches a stream of fireSonic Boom DeviceUnleashes a knockback shockwaveGravity BombThrows a gravity-warping projectileGravity InverterInverts gravity in an areaShrink RayApplies a shrink effect to a target mobMirror ShieldReflects projectiles back at attackersNecromancer's RingSummons undead alliesFrozen HeartApplies freeze/slowness to nearby entitiesHealing TotemHeals nearby playersChaos OrbApplies a random effectTempest ShardTriggers a 30-second thunderstorm
🥾 Magical Boots & Armor
Footwear with serious perks:

Anti-Gravity Boots — Float and reduce fall damage
Bouncy Boots — Bounce on landing
Cloud Walker Boots — Walk on air / water surfaces
Obsidian Armor — High protection + permanent fire resistance while worn

🪄 Wands & Builder Tools
Quality-of-life tools for builders and explorers:

Torch Wand — Instantly places torches at a distance
Structure Wand — Right-click to place structures; sneak+use to clear a 5×5 area
Quantum Pickaxe — Sneak while mining to toggle a special mining mode
Tree Capitator — Fells an entire tree in one hit
Portal Tool — Builds portals quickly

📦 Storage & Resource Items

Ender Bag — Opens your Ender Chest inventory from anywhere
XP Vacuum — Pulls all XP orbs within 32 blocks to you
Loot Magnet — Continuously pulls dropped items and XP toward you
Fortune Magnet — Attracts fortune drops
Mob Magnet — Pulls nearby mobs toward you
Experience Flask — Stores and releases experience
Bottomless Water Flask — Infinite water source in your hand
Eternal Lava Flask — Infinite lava source in your hand
Beacon-in-a-Box — Applies beacon-tier effects on right-click
Pocket Sun — Summons daylight in your vicinity
Time Dust — Manipulates local time
Speed Rune — Grants speed boost on use
Star Fragment — Rare crafting material with special effects
Phase Flask — Grants brief phasing/intangibility
Soul Jar — Sneak+use on a mob to capture its soul/name; right-click to release

🐾 Entities

Void Wisp — A new mob that inhabits void-adjacent spaces. Spawn using the Void Wisp Egg or Chaos Spawn Wand.

🪨 New Blocks

Pusher — A redstone-activatable block that pushes entities in a direction
Echo Moss — A light-emitting moss block with randomized growth behavior
Void Glass — A transparent glass-like block with void properties
Dimension Anchor (block) — Restricts or allows warping in a zone
Dimension Tile — Decorative block tied to the dimension system
Rift Stone — Displays dimensional metadata

💬 Commands

/warp — Warp to a dimension by name
/warpscroll — Bind a Warp Scroll to a dimension
/pocketdim — Manage pocket dimensions
/diminfo — Display information about the current dimension


🎯 Who Is This For?
Infinite Dimensions is great for:

Survival players who want meaningful dimension travel and powerful late-game tools
Adventure map makers needing custom dimensions and warp mechanics
Server owners wanting a content-rich utility mod that doesn't require a dozen dependencies
Creative players who love gadgets and magical items with unique, interactive effects
